name: child-controls
title: Kokiri Forest: movement, talk, crawl and ledges
actions: Run, roll and turn; equip the Bunny Hood and try again.
Talk to a Kokiri and close the message once.
Crawl through the sword tunnel, reverse and exit; climb and drop from a ledge.
expected: Fresh controls, one action per press, sane climb/crawl timing and no camera flash.

name: child-items
title: Kokiri Forest: boomerang, sticks, nuts and pickups
actions: Throw and catch the boomerang while running.
Use a stick and a nut against a Deku Baba near the Great Deku Tree.
Cut grass, collect a drop once, and pick up/throw a nearby object.
expected: One release/contact/reward, sensible recovery and no held-object jitter.

name: adult-combat
title: Forest Temple entrance: real enemies and targeting
actions: Fight the entrance Wolfos with targeted, crouching and jump attacks.
Block, take one hit, recover and try a non-magical spin.
Change shield/sword in pause and repeat the action that looks suspicious.
expected: Original-duration attacks and recovery with finer controls; world enemies still run20.

name: dungeon
title: Fire Temple: doors, platforms, switches and hammer
actions: Open a door, use a switch, then stand/turn/jump on the lift.
Push and pull a block; release partway through.
Use the hammer and open a chest when reached.
expected: No accumulated pushing, platform drift, duplicate key use or stuck control after rewards.

name: ranged
title: Lake Hylia: bow, elemental arrow and longshot
actions: Aim while moving the stick, then release it and watch the hands/arrow.
Shoot, cancel a shot, and check ammo/magic consumption.
Longshot a valid target, release and land.
expected: Stable attachments, correct aiming sensitivity, one shot/cost and normal pull speed.

name: water
title: Lake Hylia: swimming, diving, boots and bottles
actions: Enter the water, reverse direction, dive, release and resurface.
Use the empty bottle at a shallow shoreline; catch and release a creature.
For adult Iron Boots, launch water-adult next.
expected: Original elapsed swim/turn/dive timing, one scoop sound and one inventory change.

name: water-adult
title: Lake Hylia: adult swimming and Iron Boots
actions: Swim, dive and resurface.
Equip Iron Boots underwater, walk, then remove them.
Pause/change equipment while an item is active and check control returns.
expected: Sane sink/rise speed, underwater controls and equipment transitions.

name: spells
title: Fire Temple: Din, Nayru and Farore
actions: Cast Din and Nayru once each; check magic and recovery.
Set Farore's Wind, walk away and return with it.
Play and cancel an ocarina song from the inventory.
expected: One spell/cost, original waits and clean camera/control handoff.

name: ice
title: Ice Cavern: slippery movement and adverse states
actions: Move and brake on ice; encounter actual freeze damage.
Escape with buttons and with stick rotations.
Catch blue fire in the empty bottle and use it.
expected: Sane friction and recovery, fresh escape input, one bottle update. Enemy-hit variants remain exploratory.

name: slopes
title: Death Mountain Trail: steep slopes and falling
actions: Run uphill and downhill, then diagonally across a slippery face.
Try a low ledge, a higher fall and a landing.
Compare a suspicious action with --rate 20, leaving rendering120.
expected: No sixfold slope acceleration or snap-turn; fall/recovery should retain original timing.

name: horse
title: Hyrule Field: start already riding Epona
actions: Steer, use a carrot and jump a fence.
Dismount and mount again with one A press.
Watch rider/horse/shadow alignment while turning on uneven ground.
expected: Reliable A, smooth horse/rider presentation; horse gameplay deliberately remains20.

name: fishing
title: Fishing Pond: ready at the entrance with rupees
actions: Pay the owner for a rod; cast, move the lure and reel.
Catch a fish and finish the session.
expected: Sane manual blend speed, one button response and correct full minigame progression. The rod is obtained through the real owner.

name: gallery
title: Shooting Gallery: child game with rupees
actions: Pay the owner and complete one game.
Watch aiming, final shot, closing delay and control return.
expected: Correct sensitivity, no missed A and no premature gallery close.

name: stalfos
title: Forest Temple: upper bow-room duel above the pit
actions: Lock on and circle the Stalfos on the upper ring. Watch his feet, sword and shield in motion.
Block a slash, dodge a jumping slash, then counterattack. Try a crouch stab and a spin.
For the original enemy and Player cadence, relaunch this scenario with --rate 20.
expected: Player and one Stalfos move/animate/contact at120; tactical decisions and damage reactions remain20. No accelerated attacks or duplicate hits.
